description: For every countably infinite almost disjoint family A of infinite subsets of the naturals, there is an infinite set B outside A meeting every member in a finite set, and adjoining B preserves almost disjointness.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.countable_infinite_extension (A : Set (Set ℕ))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint A) (hc : A.Countable) (hi : A.Infinite) :
  ∃ B,
    B.Infinite ∧ B ∉ A ∧ (∀ S ∈ A, (S ∩ B).Finite) ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint (insert B A)
